application_code.note: No adopter-written Kyoei file exists for this fixture: its drivers are measurement harness and its configuration is declarative. The reference lines are a lower bound for a team starting cold, and the gap is the ordinary build-or-adopt difference; it counts only beside configuration and operation (frozen caveat). Kyoei supplier lines are its maintenance cost, reported, not hidden.

context.classification: per-key, listed in the configuration report; author judgment, recountable
context.reference_uncounted: Seven actor signing keys are generated inside the harness; the reference has no key-provisioning client, so an adopter builds one (application code).

machine_setup_ns.reason: Neither driver stamps the first setup process start and the first successful exchange on one clock; client setup time is context.

dependency_coverage.context: Reference joint outputs bind their draft's inputs, not the draft (2 missing, 10 extra edges); its correction and withdrawal sets are still exact. Its draft inputs are lists a client supplies; Kyoei's e33 offline derivation lists its two inputs.
dependency_coverage.unauthorized: Not recomputed on the full fixture in either arm. Consumption outside grants is exercised by the fault schedule (prohibited-disclosure, new-purpose, delegation-escalation held on all three arms); Kyoei's e01-e18 prefix count is 0.

context.counted_as: harness actions per injected fault (attack, valid control and the steps the class needs), not an operator runbook

lifecycle_segment.rule: All client actions after fault injection through first permitted repaired use, including failed attempts, acknowledgment, replacement release and re-derivation.

application_code.caveat: Build-or-adopt difference; Kyoei's supplier lines are maintained by the supplier and listed beside it.

decision.mrd: No tie. Kyoei ahead on application code, dependency coverage; reference ahead on configuration decisions, setup commands; split on concurrent throughput; tied on operational failures, recovery steps. Machine-level results neither validate nor disprove adoption: the MRD advantage in workflow adoption or operation stays undemonstrated until a second collaboration (P2.1) is costed in both arms.

mrd_gate.rule: If the reference requires no more application code, configuration or recovery and matches throughput and failures, report the tie and apply the MRD market/scope gate. Do not add mechanism to create a gap.
